  "summary": "Mei et al. investigate span readouts and selective adapter LoRA design choices for JEV entailment reranking across MC11 configurations. Selective adaptation reducing FFN trainable parameters by >50% and mean-span pooling consistently improve accuracy over all-module baselines, with combined gains reaching 3.1 pp accuracy improvement while halving parameter counts. Within reranking, pooling leads the pointer readout, while pointer excels under direct selection.",

  "introduction": "Mei et al. investigate span readout and selective adapter LoRA design choices for JEV entailment reranking across MC11 configurations.",
  "conclusion": "Selective adaptation reduces trainable parameters by >50% while improving NeoHorse-1-4B MC11 accuracy over the all-module baseline."
